quotes.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman. [...] The 2024 Worldwide Threat Assessment warns that our most sophisticated adversaries, Russia, Iran, and China, see the upcoming Presidential election as an opportunity to sow disinformation, divide Americans, and undercut our democracy. [...] Just recently, we learned that China is experimenting with AI to enhance their influence operations. Within the Department of Homeland Security, CISA is charged with protecting the security of our elections.

Mr. Oxman, Lockheed Martin and other defense manufacturers in my district use AI into their assembly lines and supply chain logistics to improve efficiency, enhance quality control, and more. Why is it important both to our economic and national security that this industry have access to cutting-edge technology in manufacturing?
And Mr. Shea, is DeepSig currently seeing any risk of IP theft or cyber infiltration targeting U.S. defense AI contractors? And what countermeasures are you developing?
